visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a black LEGO flag with a Straw Hat skull and crossbones logo against a blurred indoor event background; white text appears centered on the frame. (2) The camera pans across the deck of a LEGO Going Merry ship, showing a figure of Nami in a striped top and Sanji in a black suit holding drinks; lighting is bright and professional. (3) A panning shot reveals Usopp in the crow's nest holding a yellow spyglass, while a red and white striped sail moves slightly in the frame. (4) Zoom onto the figurehead of the ship where a LEGO Luffy figure sits; cuts follow showing Zoro with three swords and various detail shots of the ship's hull and masts. (5) Fast montage showcasing a LEGO Devil Fruit, a duel scene on a wooden platform, and a small boat with a figure of Shanks. (6) Detailed exploration of the Baratie restaurant LEGO set, revealing multiple floors, dining areas, and a kitchen filled with character figures like Zeff and Garp. (7) A man in a black shirt (the designer) is shown from the chest up, demonstrating the features of a Luffy figure with elongated rubber arms. (8) Shot of a display board holding six different character 'Wanted' posters in LEGO style; camera zooms in on several. (9) The designer stands at a podium in a large hall, speaking to an audience while a projector screen behind him displays 'LEGO NETFLIX ONE PIECE'. (10) Two men, one in a black shirt and the other in a tropical patterned shirt, pose together holding a signed poster in front of a themed backdrop.

(2) A male narrator's voice enters with high pitch and very fast speech, speaking Mandarin excitedly to introduce the product. (3) Transient SFX: Faint metallic clicks and plastic rustling sounds are audible under the music as parts are showcased. (4) Vocal inflection: The narrator shifts to a slightly lower pitch when introducing the designer, creating a bridge in the audio narrative. (5) A second male voice (the designer) speaks with a professional, moderate speed and clear articulation, accompanied by low background room tone chatter from the event. (6) Music intensity builds toward the end, maintaining the upbeat mood as the narrator's arousal remains high during the final summary.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To reveal the new LEGO One Piece collaboration sets, specifically highlighting that the lead designer is Taiwanese and showcasing the high level of detail and character accuracy in the figures.
